system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Diplomacy and Performance, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Music Lore, Theater Lore, Storytelling Lore, Festivals Lore.
system.description: You earned your living with music, stories, or the stage. You learned to win a difficult audience and keep a performance alive when everything behind the curtain went wrong.
